summary: The first job producer: notice that the cartographer's map and the game's compass disagree about a room's exits, and ask for one reconciliation per room

coordination.notes: No text is parsed. The snapshot side is the cartographer's own moves (the same list presentationBridge's exitsFor pairs with links); the stream side is gameStream's compass tag, read through gameLink's existing streamCharacterState accessor. Only compass bearings are compared: the compass never reports `go gate`, `climb ladder` or `out`, so including them would report a divergence in every room with a door - a check that always fires, which carries as much information as one that never does. The host wiring also closes a gap G0 left: EvidenceStore had no constructor anywhere in src/, so a job's inputRefs would have gone on dangling. The host now builds one and hands it to JobStore.
coordination.deviations: Two files outside the increment's touches list. `expandCompassDirection` went into src/lib/isometric-board-layout.mjs (plus its .d.mts) rather than into the new module, because that file already owns COMPASS_ANCHORS and a second copy of the compass vocabulary beside a consumer would be free to drift from the anchors. Lane L also edits that file; the addition is an appended export, so a conflict resolves by keeping both.
